_instructions: One entry per review item: {"points": <int>, "verdict": "<one line>", "reasoning": "<why, referencing the code>", "evidence": ["<file:line or snippet>"]}. points must be between 0 and the item maximum shown below.

o1_hotpath.criterion: 用 OrderedDict.move_to_end 或双向链表实现 O(1) 的 get/set，不是每次排序或线性查找

module_separation.criterion: 三个模块职责清晰，__init__.py 只做再导出，不塞实现

sentinel.criterion: 区分 ttl=None 与省略 ttl 用私有模块级 sentinel（object()），不是 "default" 字符串或 -1 魔数
